summary: Bilinear interpolation of a 4-component float vector. Writes out[i] = (cornerB[i] - cornerA[i]) * t1 + (cornerC[i] - cornerA[i]) * t2 + cornerA[i] for i in 0..3 using a2 as the base corner and a3/a4 as the two edge corners, weighted by scalar factors a5 and a6. Returns the out pointer (a1).

operations.description: result = a1; cache the destination (out) pointer in eax for the eventual return value.
out[0] = (edgeA[0] - base[0]) * weightA + (edgeB[0] - base[0]) * weightB + base[0]; bilinear interpolation of component 0.
out[1] = (edgeA[1] - base[1]) * weightA + (edgeB[1] - base[1]) * weightB + base[1]; bilinear interpolation of component 1.
out[2] = (edgeA[2] - base[2]) * weightA + (edgeB[2] - base[2]) * weightB + base[2]; bilinear interpolation of component 2.
out[3] = (edgeA[3] - base[3]) * weightA + (edgeB[3] - base[3]) * weightB + base[3]; bilinear interpolation of component 3.
return result; __stdcall function returns the out pointer (a1) in eax.
